rationale: M37.15 objc dual-lens (#608) gate fixture. OBJCD5 — pointer/object-return C helper functions parse their defining declarator NESTED (`static NSArray * fn(...)` is function_definition > pointer_declarator > function_declarator; `static NSDictionary<...> * fn` adds a generic_specifier sibling). The pre-fix direct-child lookup missed them: 46 of 110 C helpers across afnetworking (49 .m) + sdwebimage (104 .m) were dropped, and because the function was never symbolized activeScope stayed global so its ENTIRE body (calls/uses/instantiates) was suppressed — 180 missing differential edges total (60 afnetworking + 120 sdwebimage), both corpora previously ~97% coverage. OBJCD6 — macro-invocation-as-declaration inside an @implementation ivar block (`LOCK_DECLARE(_lock);` expands to `os_unfair_lock _lock;`) parses as a call_expression at class scope; the pre-fix scope-only gate (activeScope != global) fabricated `calls Widget -> LOCK_DECLARE`. A real execution body (method/function/block) is now required for message/call/uses edges. Fixed + verified: both corpora back to 100%/0/0.
